notes: Hartford CT urban core, 12 contiguous towns (~142k parcels) from ONE source (CT CAMA & Parcel Layer 2024), so the land-value surface is seamless across town lines. See run_hartfordmetro.py.

VALUE-ONLY: the statewide layer has no shared land-use classification (each town uses its own CAMA/zoning codes with no description), so category filters and the Underused tab are disabled (hideUnderutilized).

Houston-style jurisdiction treatment: parcels tagged by `jurisdiction` (town); dropdown lights/dims towns. Staggered CT revaluations mean mixed base years (2021-2024) — valuation_year ships per parcel and is shown in the popup.
Condos have no per-unit land value in CT (land=0), so ~9.5k parcels flag as erroneous in land modes.
